title: Exercise bug fixes
description: Before and after for five product bugs the smoke exercises found: toasts that never fired (wire shape of event visibility), a Faction card taller than a 1280x720 window, a flickering turn redo bar, duplicate redo auto-plays, and prepared secondary plans that were dropped before their window opened. Mocked game, no backend; the before shots were taken on the base commit (smoke-ui-exercises-2026-10-08) with TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before and are committed as PNGs, the after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- AQ.

shots.heading: Another player's action - before
shots.caption: A public event in the shape the server really sends (visibility is the object {"visibility":"public"}). The client compared it with the string "public", so the corner box stays empty: no action toast ever fired in a real game.

shots.heading: Another player's action - after
shots.caption: Same event: "Player 2 played Sabotage". Event visibility is decoded in one place (visibilityKind / isPublicEvent); a plain string still works, an unknown shape reads as not public.

shots.heading: Turn recap - before
shots.caption: A tactical turn followed by the next seat's action selection, with the recap setting on. No recap toast (seed 1001/21 in the smoke harness: 0 recap toasts across 91 turn menus).

shots.heading: Turn recap - after
shots.caption: The recap toast appears when the next seat starts its action (same seed in the harness: 28 recap toasts, 17 action toasts on the recap seat instead of 1).

shots.heading: Faction card, 1280x720 - before
shots.caption: The card hangs below the window: its bottom edge is cut off (box 211 to 787 in a 720 px high window).

shots.heading: Faction card, 1280x720 - after
shots.caption: When neither side of the trigger has room, the card goes beside it and its bottom edge stays on screen; it scrolls inside its own max height.

shots.heading: Faction card, phone - before
shots.caption: On a phone the card is a bottom sheet (unchanged by the fix).

shots.heading: Faction card, phone - after
shots.caption: Same sheet, still inside the screen.

shots.heading: Redo bar while the round replays - before
shots.caption: While the auto-play request runs the Restore button leaves the bar and comes back afterwards: the flicker, and a click aimed at it can land on a detached element.

shots.heading: Redo bar while the round replays - after
shots.caption: Restore stays in place (disabled) while the request runs; only the Replay button is hidden. The component test asserts it is the very same DOM node across the busy period.

shots.heading: Redo bar at the hand-off - before
shots.caption: Looks the same, but the status was re-fetched after every response (new callbacks per render), so the bar re-rendered continuously: see the request counts below.

shots.heading: Redo bar at the hand-off - after
shots.caption: Same bar, with a stable status: one read per change instead of a request loop.

shots.heading: Prepared plan, another seat asked - before
shots.caption: The viewer saved a plan (chip: Prepared). The engine then asks the third seat, so view.active_player is no longer the primary; the strategic action was detected through active_player and vanished, and the saved plan was dropped.

shots.heading: Prepared plan, another seat asked - after
shots.caption: The primary now comes from the event log: the chip stays Prepared and the plan is still stored when the viewer's own question opens.
